steps.label: Book a screening visit
steps.description: Choose a licensed screening centre and a time. In this prototype the booking is simulated and nothing is booked.

steps.label: Consent and doctor's visit
steps.description: You sign the agreement and meet a doctor, each partner on their own. The doctor asks about your health and family.

steps.label: Blood sample
steps.description: A trained person takes blood at the centre, during the same visit. Samples go to the laboratories.

steps.label: Laboratory work starts
steps.description: The laboratory receives the sample and starts the tests.

timer.source: D1 3.8 and D2 11.5.1: laboratory work starts within 24 hours

steps.label: Joint report is ready
steps.description: One joint report is prepared for the couple and sent to the doctor. The genetic part takes longer than the other tests.

timer.source: Abu Dhabi: not more than 21 days in more than 90 percent of cases (D1 3.8.6). Dubai: around 4 weeks from receiving both samples (D2 11.5.6). Typical: 14 days in the Abu Dhabi workflow image (D1 App. 15, least reliable row set). The standards disagree with each other and with press figures; the value is parameterised per emirate policy, never hard-coded.

steps.label: Result is explained
steps.description: The doctor shares the result. Partners may be contacted separately.
steps.external_system: Report feed between laboratory and doctor (simulated)

steps.label: Counselling is booked
steps.description: If the result needs it, a counselling visit is booked. You can also say no thank you.

steps.label: Counselling is done
steps.description: A trained professional explains the result and the choices that exist. They do not tell you what to decide.

steps.label: Declaration is signed
steps.description: You sign a statement that the result was explained to you.

steps.label: Certificate is issued
steps.description: The screening report that is needed for the marriage contract is issued. It is valid for a limited time.

steps.label: Report goes to the judicial department
steps.description: The report is made available to the judicial department. In this prototype the hand-off is simulated.

steps.label: Case is closed
steps.description: The follow-up steps are finished or have been declined, and the case is closed.

next_actions.label: Record that the certificate was issued

notices: Every outside system shown on this page is simulated. Nothing is booked, sent or issued.
All people and results in this prototype are made up (synthetic).
These labels are a draft. The clinical lead's sign-off is pending.
